# Salaam

> A persistent session service for terminal coding and unattended agent work, built on Pi.

Salaam runs a service on your machine or execution host. Close the terminal and the session, its approvals and results stay; reattach later from a terminal, over SSH or from an editor that speaks ACP. macOS and Linux are supported; Windows is not currently tested. Apache 2.0.

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://docs.salaam.sh): guides and reference
- [Quickstart](https://docs.salaam.sh/quickstart/): your first session
- [Installation](https://docs.salaam.sh/install/): requirements and installer options
